newsitem.title: FRANCE: Parties asked to help set Algeria poll date.
newsitem.headline: Parties asked to help set Algeria poll date.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual has invited political leaders to help him set a date for local elections, promised this year and seen by officials as a key step in returning Algeria to normal from long-running violence.
A presidential statement carried by Algeria's official news agency APS said invitations for party leaders to meet Zeroual had gone out. It did not say when the talks would take place.
Local elections are part of the final stage of Zeroual's efforts to rebuild Algeria's institutions after nearly six years of violence which officials blame on Moslem fundamentalists.
Last month, the country held its first multi-party general election since the authorities scrapped one in January 1992.
